data.acquisitionSummary: Current Orange Mobicarte starts at EUR2.99 online. Orange’s current recharge table directly establishes line-validity tiers: EUR5 extends the line 1 month, while EUR10 and higher eligible recharges extend line validity 6 months. Mobicarte requires identity registration and the current offer is for people resident in or able to justify a stable link with metropolitan France.

keep.action: Use an eligible EUR10-or-higher recharge before each six-month line-validity period expires. Current Orange recharge tables explicitly show EUR10 recharges extending line validity by 6 months.

data.chinaActivation: HOLD for typical overseas-only acquisition: current Mobicarte requires identification and is reserved to people residing in or able to justify a stable link with metropolitan France.
data.kyc: Valid identity/identification is mandatory for prepaid Mobicarte; current offer eligibility also requires residence in or a stable link to metropolitan France.
data.payment: Existing Mobicarte customers can recharge online by bank card 24/7.
data.wifiCalling: Not relied on for this route decision.
data.roamingSms: Mobicarte can use international mode and current recharges include roaming in Europe on eligible products. Reviewed evidence does not establish the target long-term inbound-SMS/OTP behavior in China or other non-Europe destinations.
data.holdReason: Retention economics are now verified, but France residence/stable-link eligibility plus unverified non-Europe inbound OTP behavior keep this route HOLD for the target overseas use case.
data.tariffSummary: EUR2.99 Mobicarte Mini; EUR10 recharge extends line validity 6 months, about EUR20/year for retention; France-link/ID constraints apply.
guideSteps: Only consider the route if you satisfy Orange’s current France residence/stable-link and identification requirements.
Use an eligible EUR10+ recharge before each six-month line-validity period expires.
Do not assume China/non-Europe OTP reception without route-specific current evidence.
